name: extrudo
description: Parametric CAD for 3D printing, in your browser. Offline version for your Mac, Windows or Linux computer is also available.

paragraphs: Parametric CAD for 3D printing, in your browser. Free and open source, try it now at: extrudo.org

Sketch a profile, pull it into a solid, round the edges, and change one number to watch the whole part follow. Extrudo is built for people who print: brackets, boxes, clips, enclosures and the replacement part you need by tonight. It runs in a browser tab, works offline once it has loaded, keeps your designs on your own machine and needs no account. Under the friendly interface sits exact geometry (real circles and fillets, not a mesh of triangles), so what you design is what comes out of the printer.

It follows the workflow people know from desktop CAD (sketch, features, timeline, parameters everywhere) with a faster, friendlier interface. It is inspired by that workflow and shares no code or artwork with any such product.

requirements.text: It runs in a browser tab, works offline once it has loaded, keeps your designs on your own machine and needs no account.
To run it yourself, docker run -d -p 8080:80 ghcr.io/zoltanf/extrudo serves the app on (docs/deploy.md, "Self-hosting with Docker").

The two WASM builds (the OpenCascade geometry kernel and the sketch solver) are not in git: pnpm dev, pnpm build and pnpm check download the build that matches your checkout from this repository's releases, using the GitHub CLI (gh auth login once) or a plain download when the repository is public.
